newsitem.title: USA: CSCE sugar called to open unchanged.
newsitem.headline: CSCE sugar called to open unchanged.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open unchanged following a whipsaw session Thursday, in which funds took the market to life-of-contract highs before selling off in a reversal.
Many dealers are expecting a weak session Friday, given Thursday's lower settlement. Sell-stops are believed to be amassed under 11.50 cents in the active October contract.
October closed 0.09 cent lower Thursday at 11.58 cents a lb after trading from 11.56 to 11.87 cents. The LIFFE October contract was 40 cents higher at $323.60.

Brazilian sugar stocks in the center-south growing region totaled 1.09 million on July 16, 496,000 tonnes less than at the same stage last year. Since the start of the harvest, Brazil has exported 14 million tonnes.
